cover.desc: Full color, high-key and cold. A vast white space with no horizon, painted as flat pale fields with hard-edged shadow shapes. One small figure walks away from the viewer into it — pale silver hair loose down her back, dark short coat, bare hands at her sides, already far off and getting smaller. Behind the viewer's shoulder, blurred and dark and enormous by contrast, the edge of an archway and a black-sleeved arm held out as if it has just let go. Bone white, ice blue, one thin warm line at the very bottom edge of frame. Colored lineart, enormous negative space.
